svg.title: Token usage: transcripts in, totals out
svg.desc: Every 30 seconds usage.mjs reads only the bytes appended to Claude Code transcripts in ~/.claude/projects, parses assistant usage lines, keeps one record per message id and request id, attributes each run to a team member and workstream, and builds daily aggregates. Only those numbers reach the Usage view over server-sent events and /api/usage; transcript text never leaves the server.
